[DianXue Gong]: freeze the nearest target within 2 tiles in front of you (+/-45 degrees) for 5 minutes. Any attack breaks the seal. Costs 15 stamina. 10s cooldown.
[Ge Shan Da Niu]: a forceful palm strike dealing 30%% weapon damage to the target and 50%% to up to 2 nearby targets. Costs 20 Energy. No cooldown.
[Golden Toad Leap]: leap toward the mouse, dealing minor damage and knocking down targets in the landing area. Costs 15 Energy. 6s cooldown.
[GuiXi Gong]: vanish into ghost form for 10s. Costs 50 Energy. 5min cooldown.

[KaiShan Jin]: your attacks unleash three shockwaves in a frontal cone for 25~100%% weapon damage, closer hits harder. Costs 25 stamina. Sub-node 1 removes the cooldown.
[Bison Charge]: charge forward, shoving aside every zombie in your path. Costs 20 Energy. 20s cooldown.
[Shenxing]: movement speed +100%% for 5s. Costs 15 Energy. 10s cooldown.
[Little Li Flying Dagger]: hurl a carried short-blade weapon (vanilla small blades included) for 100%% of the item's damage. 2s cooldown.

[ZhenDi Shi]: slam the ground; all targets within 2 tiles take 20%% weapon damage and are knocked down. Costs 20 stamina. No cooldown.
